description:
The proposal comprises the construction of a contemporary, lightweight roof extension set back from the existing front parapet of the locally listed building at 6 The Broadway, Hornsey. The extension is intended to provide additional operational floorspace for the existing bakery, including office and staff accommodation, lift access, WC and storage facilities, and an associated discreet roof terrace.

There is no change of use proposed; the building will remain in its lawful commercial use as a bakery (Use Class E).

The development does not involve the creation of residential dwellings, does not exceed 18 metres or 7 storeys in height, and therefore a Fire Statement is not required.

The proposal does not relate to Permission In Principle or Technical Details Consent, and does not constitute public service infrastructure development.
